message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the country. Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines, including arts and humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, law, medicine, and public health. Its main campus sits on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, while additional campuses include the Columbia University Medical Center in Washington Heights and the Columbia Business School in Midtown. The university is known for its rigorous academics, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni, many of whom have gone on to become leaders in academia, government, industry, and the arts.
